system.description:
This devilish song draws the eyes of customers to the wares of the Elven merchants. If successful, add +1D to Conspicuous to attract attention for commercial or spectacular endeavors. Extra successes add +1D each. This song can also be sung to aid Haggling when selling Elven goods.

Obstacle: Will of Customer

Actions: 4

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 145
